description: Remove a workspace-scoped soft-bounce escalation for an exact recipient associated with the company, then reactivate bounced company subscribers. Global invalid-recipient, workspace hard-bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppressions are protected.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

email.description: Exact recipient email address to inspect or clean up.

region.description: Deprecated: accepted and ignored. It previously limited a provider-side suppression lookup, which no longer happens.

name: remove_recipient_suppression

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `remove_recipient_suppression` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

remainingSuppression.description: The recipient suppression status after cleanup record returned by Sequenzy.

removed.description: Whether a workspace soft-bounce escalation was removed.

removedLocalBounce.description: Whether the workspace-local soft-bounce escalation was removed.

removedSesRegions.description: Always empty. Sequenzy suppresses solely from its own bounce table and neither reads nor writes the email provider's suppression list. Retained for response compatibility.

items.description: Unused; this array is always empty.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
